title: Bug on llama2-chinese conversation templates
body:
Hi, I noticed that there may be one bug of your prompt template for llama2-chinese conversation template.

For llama2-chinese, in fastchat/conversations.py line 945:

`register_conv_template(
    Conversation(
        name="llama2-chinese",
        system_message="<s>{system_message}</s>",
        roles=("Human", "Assistant", "System"),
        messages=(),
        offset=0, 
`

Is it ‘system_message‘ or ‘system_template‘ here? It seems that ‘system_template‘ is more reasonable.
